title: Microsoft Viva: Insights and Copilot Analytics expand in GCC and GCC High
summary: The briefing accurately separates the government-cloud roadmap plan from Microsoft's documented availability and licensing. It should report the conflicting dashboard licence thresholds in Microsoft's pages and extend the two feature-access paths to the actual setting.

claims.claim: The web app control can be reached through Microsoft 365 admin center > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy.
claims.quote:
Select Create a policy.
Name the policy and select the app and feature for which you'd like to set the policy.
Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off to enable or disable the feature.
claims.fix: The path reaches the policy wizard but stops before its control. Use 'Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > app > feature > Access setting'; specify that the app and feature selections are for the Viva Insights web app, as described at https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/control-access-admin-center.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide policy disabling the web app.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone
